item.title: Greenville prepping for possibility of winter weather
item.description: PITT COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- With the potential of a severe winter weather event, the City of Greenville has made adjustments to programs, services and facility hours. The City said that with the winter storm watch being issued for the Greenville area, residents are advised to expect disruptions and avoid travel during the supposed storm. [...]

item.title: Kinston mayor declares State of Emergency, imposes curfew
item.description: KINSTON, N.C. (WNCT) -- Mayor Moore has declared a State of Emergency and imposed a curfew in Kinston due to the possibility of severe winter weather. The Mayor's declaration also included a curfew for the city: The Kinston Police Department has advised residents to remain off the roadways and stay indoors unless travel is essential.
